articles.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin
articles.titleZh: 特朗普宣布与俄罗斯达成柴油协议，泽伦斯基称这是给普京的礼物
articles.summary: Expanded English reading feature based on the headline, with background context and critical-reading guidance. Use the original publisher link to verify the specific reported facts.
articles.summaryZh: 扩展版英文阅读专题：围绕标题补充背景知识与新闻辨析方法。具体新闻事实请以原始媒体报道为准。
articles.sourceNote: Expanded learning feature based on headline · verify details with original publisher

sentences.en: Donald Trump has announced a deal involving Russian diesel, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has criticised the move and described it as a gift to Vladimir Putin. The disagreement places energy policy and international politics in the same debate. The headline alone, however, does not explain the exact terms of the deal or how it would work.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普宣布了一项涉及俄罗斯柴油的协议，而乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基批评了这一举动，并将其形容为送给弗拉基米尔·普京的礼物。这场分歧将能源政策与国际政治放在同一场讨论中。不过，仅凭标题还无法了解协议的具体条款及其运作方式。
sentences.note: while 连接两个相对照的情况；described it as… = 将其描述为……。

sentences.en: Fuel is closely connected to the wider economy. Transport companies need diesel to move goods, farmers use it to operate machinery, and many businesses depend on reliable energy supplies. When fuel becomes more expensive, the cost of delivering food and other products can also rise. Governments therefore face pressure to keep energy affordable while managing diplomatic and security concerns.
sentences.zh: 燃料与整体经济密切相关。运输公司需要柴油运送货物，农民用它驱动机械，许多企业也依赖稳定的能源供应。当燃料价格上涨时，食品和其他产品的运输成本也可能随之上升。因此，各国政府既面临降低能源成本的压力，也需要处理外交和安全方面的顾虑。
sentences.note: be connected to = 与……有关；therefore 表示因果推论。

sentences.en: Russia's role in global energy markets has been a sensitive issue since its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Governments have debated sanctions, trade restrictions and ways to reduce dependence on Russian energy. Any new arrangement involving Russian fuel can therefore raise questions about policy consistency and the wider consequences for Ukraine and its partners.
sentences.zh: 自俄罗斯于2022年全面入侵乌克兰以来，俄罗斯在全球能源市场中的角色一直是敏感议题。各国政府一直在讨论制裁、贸易限制以及减少对俄罗斯能源依赖的方法。因此，任何涉及俄罗斯燃料的新安排都可能引发对政策一致性及其对乌克兰和合作伙伴影响的讨论。
sentences.note: has been a sensitive issue 是现在完成时，表示这一议题持续至今。

sentences.en: To assess this story fairly, readers should look beyond the competing political descriptions. What exactly does the agreement cover? Which organisations or companies are involved? When would it take effect, and what restrictions would remain in place? The answers should come from the full report and official documents, not from assumptions based on a headline.
sentences.zh: 要公平评估这则新闻，读者应超越相互竞争的政治表述。协议具体涵盖什么？涉及哪些机构或企业？何时生效？还有哪些限制继续存在？这些问题应通过完整报道和官方文件来回答，而不能只凭标题作出推断。
sentences.note: look beyond = 不局限于；What exactly does…? 是特殊疑问句。

sentences.en: News literacy means separating confirmed details from a politician's interpretation of events. Compare statements from the people involved with independent reporting, check publication dates and note what remains uncertain. The headline identifies the central disagreement; the full evidence is needed to understand its practical impact.
sentences.zh: 新闻素养意味着区分已确认的细节与政治人物对事件的解读。应比较当事人的表态和独立媒体的报道，核对发布日期，并留意仍不确定的部分。标题指出了争议核心；要理解实际影响，还需要查看完整证据。
sentences.note: separate A from B = 区分 A 与 B；what remains uncertain 是宾语从句。

vocab.zh: 美国政治人物唐纳德·特朗普；此处为新闻标题中的人物名称。

grammar.title: 新闻阅读策略
grammar.body: 先读标题，确认人物、行动和争议点；再阅读正文，核对时间、来源和直接引语。不要仅凭标题推断全部事实。

grammar.title: 事实与观点
grammar.body: 区分报道确认的事实、消息来源的说法和作者的分析。遇到有争议的标签或评价性词语时，查看是谁使用了这个说法。

grammar.title: 本篇句型
grammar.body: involving Russian diesel 是后置修饰语，说明 deal 涉及的内容。 but 连接转折关系；cannot show 表示“无法呈现”。 what each leader said 是宾语从句；check 后可接多个并列内容。

articles.readingText:
Donald Trump has announced a deal involving Russian diesel, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has criticised the move and described it as a gift to Vladimir Putin. The disagreement places energy policy and international politics in the same debate. The headline alone, however, does not explain the exact terms of the deal or how it would work.

Fuel is closely connected to the wider economy. Transport companies need diesel to move goods, farmers use it to operate machinery, and many businesses depend on reliable energy supplies. When fuel becomes more expensive, the cost of delivering food and other products can also rise. Governments therefore face pressure to keep energy affordable while managing diplomatic and security concerns.

Russia's role in global energy markets has been a sensitive issue since its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Governments have debated sanctions, trade restrictions and ways to reduce dependence on Russian energy. Any new arrangement involving Russian fuel can therefore raise questions about policy consistency and the wider consequences for Ukraine and its partners.

To assess this story fairly, readers should look beyond the competing political descriptions. What exactly does the agreement cover? Which organisations or companies are involved? When would it take effect, and what restrictions would remain in place? The answers should come from the full report and official documents, not from assumptions based on a headline.

News literacy means separating confirmed details from a politician's interpretation of events. Compare statements from the people involved with independent reporting, check publication dates and note what remains uncertain. The headline identifies the central disagreement; the full evidence is needed to understand its practical impact.

articles.title: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
articles.titleZh: 分析：特朗普对俄罗斯协议的震惊凸显了遏制燃油价格的压力越来越大
articles.summary: Expanded English reading feature based on the headline, with background context and critical-reading guidance. Use the original publisher link to verify the specific reported facts.
articles.summaryZh: 扩展版英文阅读专题：围绕标题补充背景知识与新闻辨析方法。具体新闻事实请以原始媒体报道为准。
articles.sourceNote: Expanded learning feature based on headline · verify details with original publisher

sentences.en: The report examines the political pressure to curb fuel prices and links that pressure to a reported agreement involving Russia. The key question is how governments can respond when households and businesses are worried about the cost of energy. A headline can identify the debate, but the full article is needed to establish the details and the evidence behind the analysis.
sentences.zh: 这篇报道分析了抑制燃油价格的政治压力，并将这种压力与一项据称涉及俄罗斯的协议联系起来。核心问题是，当家庭和企业担忧能源成本时，政府该如何应对。标题可以指出讨论主题，但要确认具体情况及分析依据，仍需阅读完整文章。
sentences.note: curb = 控制、抑制；the evidence behind… = ……背后的证据。

sentences.en: Fuel prices rarely depend on one factor alone. The cost of crude oil, refining capacity, shipping, taxes, currency movements and local distribution can all affect what customers pay. A change in international supply may influence prices, but the final effect can differ from one country to another because each market has its own rules and infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 燃油价格很少只由一个因素决定。原油成本、炼油能力、运输、税收、汇率变化和本地配送都会影响消费者最终支付的价格。国际供应的变化可能影响价格，但由于各国市场的规则和基础设施不同，最终影响也会有所差异。
sentences.note: rarely…alone 表示“很少单独……”；what customers pay 是名词性从句。

sentences.en: Governments have several possible tools, including temporary tax changes, targeted support for households, strategic reserves and adjustments to energy policy. Each option involves trade-offs. Support may reduce immediate pressure on consumers, for example, but it can also place demands on public finances. Measures that increase supply may take time to produce results.
sentences.zh: 政府可以采取多种措施，包括临时调整税收、向特定家庭提供支持、动用战略储备以及调整能源政策。每种选择都有取舍。例如，补贴可能减轻消费者眼前的压力，但也会增加公共财政负担。能够增加供应的措施则可能需要时间才能见效。
sentences.note: including 后列举例子；trade-offs 指为获得某种好处而必须接受的代价。

sentences.en: An agreement involving a major energy producer can attract attention because markets respond not only to current supply but also to expectations about future supply. Still, a political announcement does not automatically mean that fuel will become cheaper. The terms, timing, implementation and response of suppliers all matter.
sentences.zh: 涉及主要能源生产国的协议容易受到关注，因为市场不仅会对当前供应作出反应，也会对未来供应的预期作出反应。不过，政治声明并不意味着燃油一定会降价。协议条款、时间安排、执行情况和供应商的反应都很重要。
sentences.note: not only…but also… = 不仅……而且……；does not automatically mean = 并不必然意味着。

sentences.en: When reading analysis, distinguish a confirmed event from an explanation of what it might mean. Look for data, named sources and alternative interpretations. Ask whether the writer explains uncertainty and whether the conclusion follows from the evidence. These habits help readers understand economic news without treating a headline as a complete answer.
sentences.zh: 阅读分析报道时，应区分已确认的事件与对其可能意义的解释。留意数据、具名消息来源和其他解释。思考作者是否说明了不确定性，以及结论是否有证据支持。这样的习惯能帮助读者理解经济新闻，而不是把标题当作完整答案。
sentences.note: distinguish A from B = 区分 A 与 B；whether 引导宾语从句。

vocab.zh: 分析；对事件原因和影响进行解释。
vocab.ex: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
vocab.exZh: 分析：特朗普对俄罗斯协议的震惊凸显了遏制燃油价格的压力越来越大
vocab.tip: 请结合本篇新闻标题和正文语境理解；阅读原文时留意该词的搭配。

vocab.tip: curb fuel prices = 抑制燃油价格；curb 也可作名词，表示路缘。

vocab.ex: An analysis article usually explains possible causes and consequences, so readers should distinguish the reported facts from the writer's interpretation.

articles.readingText:
The report examines the political pressure to curb fuel prices and links that pressure to a reported agreement involving Russia. The key question is how governments can respond when households and businesses are worried about the cost of energy. A headline can identify the debate, but the full article is needed to establish the details and the evidence behind the analysis.

Fuel prices rarely depend on one factor alone. The cost of crude oil, refining capacity, shipping, taxes, currency movements and local distribution can all affect what customers pay. A change in international supply may influence prices, but the final effect can differ from one country to another because each market has its own rules and infrastructure.

Governments have several possible tools, including temporary tax changes, targeted support for households, strategic reserves and adjustments to energy policy. Each option involves trade-offs. Support may reduce immediate pressure on consumers, for example, but it can also place demands on public finances. Measures that increase supply may take time to produce results.

An agreement involving a major energy producer can attract attention because markets respond not only to current supply but also to expectations about future supply. Still, a political announcement does not automatically mean that fuel will become cheaper. The terms, timing, implementation and response of suppliers all matter.

When reading analysis, distinguish a confirmed event from an explanation of what it might mean. Look for data, named sources and alternative interpretations. Ask whether the writer explains uncertainty and whether the conclusion follows from the evidence. These habits help readers understand economic news without treating a headline as a complete answer.

articles.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
articles.titleZh: 美国在MOVE法庭上公布对国际刑事法院的制裁，谴责其为“对法治的攻击”
articles.summary: Expanded English reading feature based on the headline, with background context and critical-reading guidance. Use the original publisher link to verify the specific reported facts.
articles.summaryZh: 扩展版英文阅读专题：围绕标题补充背景知识与新闻辨析方法。具体新闻事实请以原始媒体报道为准。
articles.sourceNote: Expanded learning feature based on headline · verify details with original publisher

sentences.en: The headline reports that the United States has announced sanctions involving the International Criminal Court, commonly known as the ICC. It also says that the court condemned the move as an assault on the rule of law. These are strong descriptions of a legal and political dispute, so readers should check the full report to understand who made each statement and what measures were announced.
sentences.zh: 标题报道称，美国宣布了涉及国际刑事法院（通常简称 ICC）的制裁措施。标题还称，该法院谴责这一举动是对法治的攻击。这些都是对法律和政治争议的强烈表述，因此读者应查看完整报道，弄清每项说法由谁提出，以及具体宣布了哪些措施。
sentences.note: commonly known as… = 通常被称为……；what measures were announced 是宾语从句。

sentences.en: The rule of law is the principle that public power should be exercised according to established laws and that legal rules should be applied fairly. International courts operate in a complicated environment: their authority, jurisdiction and ability to enforce decisions may be debated by governments and legal experts. Disagreement about a court does not, by itself, explain the legal basis of a particular action.
sentences.zh: 法治是一项原则，即公共权力应依据既定法律行使，法律规则也应得到公平适用。国际法院所处的环境相当复杂：其权力、管辖范围和执行裁决的能力，都可能受到政府和法律专家的讨论。对某个法院存在分歧，本身并不能解释某项具体行动的法律依据。
sentences.note: the principle that… 中 that 引导同位语从句；by itself = 单凭这一点。

sentences.en: Sanctions can take different forms. Depending on the rules involved, they may restrict travel, financial transactions or access to certain services. The exact scope matters: a headline may use the broad word sanctions, while the official announcement specifies who is affected, which restrictions apply and how long they will remain in force.
sentences.zh: 制裁可以采取不同形式。根据相关规则，制裁可能限制旅行、金融交易或使用某些服务。具体范围很重要：标题可能笼统地使用“制裁”一词，而官方公告会明确受影响对象、适用限制及其持续时间。
sentences.note: Depending on… 是现在分词短语作状语；who is affected 是宾语从句。

sentences.en: To understand the dispute, readers should identify the legal instrument behind the announcement, the reasons given by the US government and the response from the court. It is also useful to distinguish a direct quotation from a reporter's summary. Words such as condemned, assault and unlawful express different levels of judgement and should be read in context.

articles.readingText:
The headline reports that the United States has announced sanctions involving the International Criminal Court, commonly known as the ICC. It also says that the court condemned the move as an assault on the rule of law. These are strong descriptions of a legal and political dispute, so readers should check the full report to understand who made each statement and what measures were announced.

The rule of law is the principle that public power should be exercised according to established laws and that legal rules should be applied fairly. International courts operate in a complicated environment: their authority, jurisdiction and ability to enforce decisions may be debated by governments and legal experts. Disagreement about a court does not, by itself, explain the legal basis of a particular action.

Sanctions can take different forms. Depending on the rules involved, they may restrict travel, financial transactions or access to certain services. The exact scope matters: a headline may use the broad word sanctions, while the official announcement specifies who is affected, which restrictions apply and how long they will remain in force.

To understand the dispute, readers should identify the legal instrument behind the announcement, the reasons given by the US government and the response from the court. It is also useful to distinguish a direct quotation from a reporter's summary. Words such as condemned, assault and unlawful express different levels of judgement and should be read in context.

Legal and diplomatic reporting often contains competing claims. A careful reader checks primary documents where available, compares independent accounts and avoids assuming that one side's description is a neutral statement of fact. The important questions are what action was taken, what reasons were offered, what legal arguments are involved and what consequences may follow.
articles.readingTextZh:
标题报道称，美国宣布了涉及国际刑事法院（通常简称 ICC）的制裁措施。标题还称，该法院谴责这一举动是对法治的攻击。这些都是对法律和政治争议的强烈表述，因此读者应查看完整报道，弄清每项说法由谁提出，以及具体宣布了哪些措施。

法治是一项原则，即公共权力应依据既定法律行使，法律规则也应得到公平适用。国际法院所处的环境相当复杂：其权力、管辖范围和执行裁决的能力，都可能受到政府和法律专家的讨论。对某个法院存在分歧，本身并不能解释某项具体行动的法律依据。

制裁可以采取不同形式。根据相关规则，制裁可能限制旅行、金融交易或使用某些服务。具体范围很重要：标题可能笼统地使用“制裁”一词，而官方公告会明确受影响对象、适用限制及其持续时间。

要理解这场争议，读者应确认公告背后的法律文件、美国政府提出的理由，以及法院作出的回应。区分直接引语和记者的概述也很有帮助。condemned（谴责）、assault（攻击）和 unlawful（非法）等词带有不同程度的判断，应结合上下文理解。

法律和外交报道经常包含相互竞争的主张。谨慎的读者会在可能的情况下查阅原始文件、比较独立报道，并避免把任何一方的描述直接当成中立事实。关键问题包括：采取了什么行动、提出了什么理由、涉及哪些法律论点，以及可能产生什么后果。

articles.title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he will not watch it
articles.titleZh: JD Vance对行刑队处决表示怀疑，并表示他不会观看
articles.summary: Expanded English reading feature based on the headline, with background context and critical-reading guidance. Use the original publisher link to verify the specific reported facts.
articles.summaryZh: 扩展版英文阅读专题：围绕标题补充背景知识与新闻辨析方法。具体新闻事实请以原始媒体报道为准。

sentences.en: The headline says that JD Vance has questioned a firing-squad execution and stated that he will not watch it. The wording points to a debate about capital punishment, public responsibility and the role of political leaders. To understand the event, readers should check the original report for the exact remarks, the setting in which they were made and the legal case involved.
sentences.zh: 标题称，JD·万斯对行刑队执行死刑提出了质疑，并表示自己不会观看。这一表述指向了有关死刑、公共责任和政治领导人角色的讨论。要理解事件，读者应查看原始报道，核实其准确言论、发言场合以及涉及的法律案件。
sentences.note: has questioned 是现在完成时；stated that… 引出宾语从句。

sentences.en: Capital punishment remains a subject of debate in many societies. Supporters may argue that it provides justice for the most serious crimes or serves as a deterrent. Opponents raise concerns about wrongful convictions, unequal application and whether the state should have the power to take a life. These arguments involve legal evidence, ethical principles and different views about the purpose of punishment.
sentences.zh: 死刑在许多社会中仍然是一个有争议的话题。支持者可能认为，死刑能够为最严重的犯罪伸张正义，或起到威慑作用。反对者则关注冤案、不平等适用，以及国家是否应拥有剥夺生命的权力。这些争论涉及法律证据、伦理原则，以及对刑罚目的的不同看法。
sentences.note: may argue that… 表示“可能主张……”；whether 引导间接疑问从句。

sentences.en: A firing squad is one method of carrying out a death sentence. The use of a particular method can become part of a wider public discussion about how punishment is administered and whether a process is humane. News reports may describe official procedures, court decisions and reactions from officials, but those elements should not be confused with a complete explanation of the underlying case.
sentences.zh: 行刑队是执行死刑的一种方式。某种具体执行方式可能引发更广泛的公众讨论，例如刑罚如何实施，以及程序是否人道。新闻报道可能会介绍官方程序、法院裁决和官员反应，但这些内容不应与案件本身的完整解释混为一谈。
sentences.note: carrying out = 实施、执行；should not be confused with = 不应与……混淆。

sentences.en: When a public figure comments on an execution, it is useful to distinguish a personal reaction from an official policy position. A statement that someone will not watch an event does not, by itself, establish whether they support or oppose every aspect of the policy. The full quotation and its surrounding remarks are needed to interpret the position accurately.
sentences.zh: 当公众人物评论一次死刑执行时，应区分个人反应与正式政策立场。某人表示自己不会观看某个事件，并不能单凭这一点证明其支持或反对该政策的所有方面。要准确理解其立场，需要完整引语及其前后发言。
sentences.note: by itself = 单凭这一点；surrounding remarks = 前后相关发言。

sentences.en: Readers should verify the date, identify the legal authority responsible for the execution and check what the courts have decided. They should also separate confirmed procedural facts from moral or political arguments. Careful reading makes it possible to understand the public debate without assuming more than the evidence supports.
sentences.zh: 读者应核实日期、确认负责执行死刑的法律机构，并查看法院作出了什么裁决。还应将已确认的程序事实与道德或政治论点区分开来。认真阅读可以帮助我们理解公共讨论，而不对证据所能支持的内容作过度推断。
sentences.note: responsible for = 对……负责；without assuming more than… = 不作超出证据的推断。
